traps: the template is the Epic Stack for Remix, but it runs on React Router 7 framework mode (react-router, @react-router/node, @react-router/express, react-router.config.ts): Remix is not a framework here
@remix-run/server-runtime is still declared in dependencies, yet no source file imports it (only a TODO comment names it), and types/env.env.d.ts references @remix-run/node, which is not declared
remix-auth, remix-auth-github and remix-utils are community libraries named after Remix, not Remix itself
remix.init/package.json is a second unit, the template's setup script, with no framework
the database is SQLite through Prisma, replicated on Fly.io by LiteFS with a Consul lease: there is no compose file and no database server
Resend is called over plain fetch to api.resend.com and GitHub OAuth through remix-auth-github: neither has an SDK, both are named by RESEND_API_KEY and GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
the S3 variables point at Tigris (fly.storage.tigris.dev), not at Amazon S3
only frameworks and services are measured; the other facets are in unknown
